subject: Customer video: Wellspring Clinics — compact patient story / release & shoot logistics
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@wellspringclinics.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — short patient video for case study

Hi Olga / Marissa,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week — the team here loved the reduced inference latency demo. We discussed doing a short (2–3 minute) patient-centered video to illustrate how Redwood is helping our telehealth triage workflows.

What we need from you:
- A quick production plan / shot list so our operations team can sign off.
- The legal release (we need our counsel to review any liability language).
- A short script or talking points for the clinician and a patient (we will supply patient release separately).

Tentative availability at our HQ in SF: Dec 8–10 (half days). If those dates won’t work for your crew, we can do remote recording for the clinician and in-person for the patient.

Can you send a draft schedule and release today/tomorrow? Happy to loop our legal lead (Anil Rao) once you have a release to review.

Appreciate it — Sam
Samantha Ortiz
Director, Communications | Wellspring Clinics
[attachment: org_team_availability.xlsx]

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@wellspringclinics.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 17:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — short patient video for case study

Hi Sam — great to hear and glad the demo landed.

We can absolutely do a compact 2–3 minute patient story. Attached are:
- draft_shotlist: a one-page run-of-show and shot list for a half-day on-site (wellspring_shotlist_v1.docx)
- draft talking points for clinician + patient (draft_talking_points_v2.docx)
- standard Redwood release (release_redwood_v2.pdf) — pending any redlines from your counsel

High-level plan (quick bullets):
- Arrival & setup: 60 min (lighting, sound check, brief with clinician + patient)
- Interviews: 2 x ~8–12 min segments (clinician, patient)
- B-roll & clinician working shots: 60–90 min
- Wrap & debrief: 15–20 min

Immediate asks from your side:
1) Confirm the two on-camera participants (clinician name + patient first name only preferred for prep).
2) Preferred shoot date (you mentioned Dec 8–10).
3) Whether Wellspring’s counsel wants the release redlined (we can take edits and return a tracked version).

Proposed next steps:
- If Dec 8–10 works, we’ll book a one-hour pre-shoot call with Ops + your legal to walk the release & scope (we suggest Dec 3 or 4).
- We’ll send a one-page pre-shoot checklist to the patient and clinician (consent, clothing, environment).

I’m copying Markus (production lead) and Marissa (customer comms) who will own logistics and comms respectively.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
[attachment: wellspring_shotlist_v1.docx]

From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@wellspringclinics.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: Anil Rao <anil.rao@wellspringclinics.com>, markus_klein@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:09:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — short patient video for case study

Thanks, Olga — this looks great. Dec 9 (morning) is our preferred slot; we’ll reserve the clinic’s community room and have Ops coordinate.

Two legal notes from me that I expect Anil will confirm formally:
- Please remove or soften the broad indemnity paragraph on page 2 of release_redwood_v2.pdf — our counsel considers that non-negotiable.
- We’d like a clause that restricts medical details shown in the video to high-level descriptions (no clinical scores or PHI).

Also, the patient we plan to feature asked to review the final edit before distribution — can we add a courtesy view clause? If so, please include timing (e.g., 48 hours to respond).

I’m looping Anil for legal redline and will send our standard patient consent form separately.

Best,
Sam

Hi Sam / Anil — Markus here (production). Thanks for the quick notes — we can accommodate all three items.

What I’m sending now:
- Redlined release (release_redlined_v1.pdf) with the indemnity language softened and a courtesy-view clause (48 hours) added. [attachment: release_redlined_v1.pdf]
- Updated shot list with a shortened schedule for a morning session on Dec 9 (wellspring_shotlist_v1.docx — updated). [attachment: wellspring_shotlist_v1.docx]

Operational confirmations:
- Call: Let’s do the pre-shoot legal + ops call on Dec 3 at 10:00 AM PT — 30 minutes. Invite will follow.
- Crew: Two-person crew (DP + sound) arriving at 08:30. Portable LED + boom. We’ll bring a quick teleprompter for the clinician if helpful.
- Patient review: we will hold the final edit for up to 48 hours for review; if no comments, we proceed to distribution.

If Anil wants to run through edits live I can join the call on Dec 3 — Olga will coordinate calendar invites.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Production Lead | Redwood Inference
